speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Education for each year in the past 10 years, what is the respective ratio of Singaporeans to foreigners in Autonomous Universities for faculty members (i) on an overall basis (ii) for Humanities and Social Science-related departments (iii) on the tenure track and (iv) on the non-tenure track.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
text: We will continue to work with the AUs to build a strong Singaporean Core in our faculty.
